precautions: Keep the person away from the wet area.
Clean the spill and dry the floor.
Place a warning sign until the floor is dry.
Keep children and other vulnerable people away from the drain.
Install a secure, load-appropriate cover or barrier.
Report the uncovered drain to the responsible authority.
Keep everyone away from the exposed wire.
Do not touch the wire or nearby wet surfaces.
Arrange for a qualified electrician to isolate and repair it.
Keep the stairs clear of objects.
Use a secure handrail when available.
Provide appropriate supervision for children and people with mobility difficulties.
Keep people away from the broken glass.
Use appropriate protective equipment to collect the fragments safely.
Dispose of the fragments in a suitable, puncture-resistant container.
